ev.pt_stray_puppy.title: A puppy at the gate
ev.pt_stray_puppy.text: For three days a shaggy puppy has sat at the gate: it doesn't leave, doesn't whine, just looks at you as if it has known you forever.
ev.pt_stray_puppy.keep.ok: The puppy got a bowl, a corner by the door and, it seems, you along with them.
ev.pt_stray_puppy.chase.ok: You chased the puppy away. It kept looking back for a long time.
ev.pt_kitten.title: A kitten in the shed
ev.pt_kitten.text: A kitten is squeaking in the shed - skinny, its eyes still cloudy. Its mother was crushed by a cart on the road.
ev.pt_kitten.keep.ok: For a week you fed it from a rag soaked in milk. It lived - and now it sleeps only at your feet.
ev.pt_kitten.leave.ok: In the morning the kitten was gone from the shed.
ev.pt_child_kitten.title: A kitten under the shirt
ev.pt_child_kitten.text: {npc} came home with a kitten under {g=npc_sex:his|her} shirt: "Can it live with us? I'll feed it myself!"
ev.pt_child_kitten.yes.ok: The kitten stayed. Every evening {npc} now gives it half of {g=npc_sex:his|her} soup.
ev.pt_child_kitten.no.ok: The kitten went back where it was found. {npc} was silent all evening.
ev.pt_child_puppy.title: A puppy for {npc}
ev.pt_child_puppy.text: The neighbors' dog had puppies. For three days {npc} has followed you everywhere: "Please, just one! The smallest!"
ev.pt_child_puppy.yes.ok: {npc} lies awake half the night listening to the puppy snuffle. Now there are two of them racing around the yard.
ev.pt_child_puppy.no.ok: The puppies went to other homes. {npc} sulked for a long time, then forgot. Almost.
ev.pt_beg_dog.title: A puppy of your own
ev.pt_beg_dog.text: The neighbors have puppies, and you've already secretly named one. Now to persuade the grown-ups.
ev.pt_beg_dog.plead.success: They gave in! The puppy is yours - and of course it sleeps with you.
ev.pt_beg_dog.plead.failure: "No means no." The puppy went to someone else.
ev.pt_beg_dog.obey.ok: You didn't argue. But you still remember that puppy.
ev.pt_parrot_merchant.title: A talking bird
ev.pt_parrot_merchant.text: A traveling merchant shows a parrot at the market: the bird bows, rolls its eye and shouts a greeting in a foreign tongue. He asks a lot.
ev.pt_parrot_merchant.buy.ok: Now a parrot lives in the house - and seems to consider itself the master.
ev.pt_parrot_merchant.no.ok: Someone else bought the parrot. A pity - no one around had a bird like that.
ev.pt_parrot_nest.title: A macaw chick
ev.pt_parrot_nest.text: A hunter brought a macaw chick from the forest - still downy, with a huge beak. He says it will grow up to repeat words and outlive everyone in the house.
ev.pt_parrot_nest.keep.ok: The chick grew into a red-and-blue bird that screams at dawn louder than the rooster.
ev.pt_parrot_nest.no.ok: The hunter took the chick to the neighbors.
ev.pt_songbird.title: The bird-catcher
ev.pt_songbird.text: At the market a bird-catcher sells goldfinches and siskins in wicker cages. One sings so well that passers-by stop to listen.
ev.pt_songbird.buy.ok: The cage hangs by the window. In the mornings the house wakes to birdsong.
ev.pt_songbird.free: Buy it and set it free
ev.pt_songbird.free.ok: You opened the cage right there at the market. The bird flew off, and your heart felt light.
ev.pt_songbird.no.ok: The song stayed in your head for a long time.
ev.pt_tortoise.title: A tortoise in the garden
ev.pt_tortoise.text: A tortoise has appeared in the garden - old, scarred, and very dignified. No one knows where it came from or how old it is.
ev.pt_tortoise.keep.ok: The tortoise settled under the fig tree. They say such creatures outlive people.
ev.pt_tortoise.release.ok: You carried the tortoise past the fence. By evening it was slowly going its own way.
ev.pt_goldfish.title: Goldfish
ev.pt_goldfish.text: A peddler carries bowls of goldfish down the street - they're bred in the ponds of rich houses. Watching them, they say, is good for the soul.
ev.pt_goldfish.buy.ok: The bowl stands by the window. The fish circle slowly, and in the evenings you could watch them forever.
ev.pt_goldfish.no.ok: The peddler moved on, his bowls clinking.
ev.pt_cricket.title: A cricket in a gourd
ev.pt_cricket.text: The kids catch crickets and keep them in little gourd cages: whoever's sings the loudest is the hero of the street.
ev.pt_cricket.catch.ok: Your cricket sings so loud you can hear it three yards away.
ev.pt_cricket.no.ok: You listened to the crickets in the grass - they're fine there too.
ev.pt_mouse.title: A tame mouse
ev.pt_mouse.text: A mouse from under the floor has stopped being afraid of you: it takes crumbs from your palm and sits on your shoulder when no one is looking.
ev.pt_mouse.keep.ok: You now have a friend the size of a walnut. Just don't let the cat find out.
ev.pt_mouse.no.ok: The mouse darted back under the floor.
ev.pt_guinea_pig.title: Not for the feast
ev.pt_guinea_pig.text: Guinea pigs in the house are fattened for feast days. But one, a ginger one, you feed by hand and have already named.
ev.pt_guinea_pig.beg.ok: The ginger one was spared. She lives by the hearth and whistles when you come in.
ev.pt_guinea_pig.accept.ok: The feast was rich. You hardly ate a thing that day.
ev.pt_monkey.title: A monkey as a gift
ev.pt_monkey.text: A merchant friend has returned from distant lands and gives you a little monkey in a red cap: "Let it cheer your house."
ev.pt_monkey.accept.ok: The monkey settled in within a day - and turned the whole house upside down within the same day.
ev.pt_monkey.decline.ok: The merchant shrugged and gave it to someone grander.
ev.pt_falcon.title: A young falcon
ev.pt_falcon.text: A falconer offers a young falcon: trained, takes a bird at the first flight. One on your wrist is the mark of a noble.
ev.pt_falcon.buy.ok: The falcon sits on your glove and looks at the world as if it were all its hunting ground.
ev.pt_falcon.no.ok: A neighbor bought the falcon. Now he shows it off at every hunt.
ev.pt_mongoose.title: A mongoose under the house
ev.pt_mongoose.text: A mongoose has moved in under the house, and the snakes that crept into the storeroom are gone. The little beast already takes food from your hand.
ev.pt_mongoose.keep.ok: The mongoose became one of the family. The children call it the guardian of the house.
ev.pt_mongoose.chase.ok: The mongoose left. A month later a snake was seen in the storeroom again.
ev.pt_dog_thief.title: Barking in the night
ev.pt_dog_thief.text: In the night such barking broke out in the yard that a thief dropped his sack at the gate and vaulted the fence. {pet} is now the hero of the whole street.
ev.pt_dog_saves.title: A faithful dog
ev.pt_dog_saves.text: The youngest slipped at the river, and only a dog's teeth gripping the shirt held the child above the water. {pet} now gets the best bone in the house.
ev.pt_dog_chicken.title: The neighbor's hen
ev.pt_dog_chicken.text: The neighbor stands at the gate holding a strangled hen and nods at your yard: "{pet}! Who else?" He demands payment.
ev.pt_dog_chicken.pay.ok: You paid for the hen. The neighbor left satisfied, and the dog had to be tied up.
ev.pt_dog_chicken.argue.success: The neighbor couldn't prove it was your dog. He left grumbling.
ev.pt_dog_chicken.argue.failure: Witnesses turned up. You had to pay double and hear a lot besides.
ev.pt_cat_mice.title: Keeper of the granary
ev.pt_cat_mice.text: Fewer mice in the granary, and more "gifts" on the doorstep each morning. {pet} knows the job: noticeably more grain was saved this year.
ev.pt_cat_lap.title: A warm evening
ev.pt_cat_lap.text: Evening, the hearth, {pet} purring in your lap. It feels like nothing bad is happening anywhere in the world right now.
ev.pt_parrot_words.title: A chatty parrot
ev.pt_parrot_words.text: In front of guests the parrot loudly and clearly repeated a word you'd let slip in anger yesterday. The guests laughed till they cried; you blushed.
ev.pt_bird_song.title: Morning song
ev.pt_bird_song.text: The bird in the cage by the window began to sing before the roosters. You lay there listening and didn't want to get up.
ev.pt_tortoise_spring.title: The tortoise wakes
ev.pt_tortoise_spring.text: The tortoise crawled out from under its stone to bask in the sun. The old folks say: if the tortoise is awake, spring won't change its mind.
ev.pt_falcon_hunt.title: A good hunt
ev.pt_falcon_hunt.text: The falcon took a heron in front of the whole hunt. Your noble neighbors just exchanged glances - none of them has a bird like that.
ev.pt_monkey_mischief.title: Mischief
ev.pt_monkey_mischief.text: The monkey stole a pot of honey from the kitchen and ate it on the roof, looking down at everyone. Little harm done, a week's worth of laughs.
ev.pt_hungry_dog.title: Another mouth to feed
ev.pt_hungry_dog.text: There isn't enough food even for people. {pet} is wasting away before your eyes and looks at you as if understanding everything.
ev.pt_hungry_dog.keep.ok: You shared your portion with the dog. It got through the winter with the rest of you.
ev.pt_hungry_dog.let_go.ok: You led the dog beyond the village. It ran after you for a long time, then fell behind.
